name: Cinderfall Steps
dig_description: A collapsed forge-pit, still radiating heat. Something glows in the ash.
lore_blurb: Volcanic terraces rise above an ancient forge city. The air burns.
warden_intro: The heat amplifies with every step.
A voice, vast as the forge-fires, speaks:
"You climb toward your own end, delver."
The Kilnwarden rises from the molten stone.
warden_outro: The Kilnwarden crumbles into cooling slag.
The way to the heart of the forge lies open.
boss_intro: A great cracking sound — then silence.
And from the silence, a roar:
boss_outro: The Fury scatters into embers on the wind.
Buried beneath the ash, something ancient stirs.
